structured_output.summary: The diff implements Date.prototype.getUTCHours in its file. It calls a shared helper `date::this_time_value(agent, this)?`, which I take to be the RequireInternalSlot([[DateValue]]) check plus the slot read, then returns NaN when tv is NaN, and otherwise returns `date::hour_from_time(tv)`. The `?` propagation is intact, there are no special-cased inputs, and no fake values are returned. The gate reports build and clippy OK, 8 new passing test262 runs and 0 regressions. I could not open `crate::support::date` (it is outside the diff), so I cannot confirm that `this_time_value` performs the RequireInternalSlot check or that `hour_from_time` computes floor(tv / msPerHour) mod 24. Those are the only points still unverified. The `args`/`new_target` to `_args`/`_new_target` rename is cosmetic and harmless.
